wholePhysicalScope: Native mapped pub footprint. Wide painted front with two upper sashes and two ground-front bays, original brick chimney stacks and connected wings.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the pub elevation, paired bays, chimneys and connected rear ranges.
limitations: The model covers the inn and its attached ranges. The village’s other independent buildings remain outside this placement.
Street elevation, window count, cream and green painted front and historic lettering follow the Qualla photo. Rear openings and small secondary ornament are representative.
